# Titulo 1

## subtitulo 2

```{python}
#!pip install ipykernel jupyter
#!pip install pandas altair vega_dataset

import altair as alt

alt.data_transformers.disable_max_rows()

from vega_datasets import data

cars = data.cars()

print(cars.head())



```

```{python}
cars.info()

```

```{python}
mi_grafico = alt.Chart(cars).mark_point().encode(
    x='Miles_per_Gallon',
    y='Horsepower',
    tooltip=['Name', 'Origin', 'Miles_per_Gallon', 'Horsepower']
    ).interactive()

display(mi_grafico)

print("Gráfico generado")

```

```{python}

alt.Chart(cars).mark_point(filled=True).encode(
    x='Miles_per_Gallon',
    y='Horsepower',
    color='Origin',
    tooltip=['Name', 'Origin', 'Miles_per_Gallon', 'Horsepower']
    ).interactive()

```

### subtitulo 3

- lista
    - elemento 1
    - elemnto 2


```{python}

alt.Chart(cars).mark_bar().encode(
    alt.X('Origin', sort='-y'),
    alt.Y('mean(Weight_in_lbs)'),
    tooltip=['Origin', 'mean(Weight_in_lbs)']
).properties(
    width=200,
    height=200
)



```


```{python}
alt.Chart(cars).mark_line(point=True).encode(
    alt.X('Year'),
    alt.Y('mean(Weight_in_lbs)'),
    alt.Color('Origin')

).properties(
    width=600
).interactive()
```
